description.value: Pho Express & Chill is a Vietnamese restaurant in Vancouver's West End serving pho noodle soups, vermicelli bowls, bánh mì sandwiches, and spring rolls with both dine-in and online pickup ordering. The menu spans a wide range of proteins as well as no-meat options, with vegetarian items flagged in the menu legend. Its Bute Street address sits just a few blocks from the Stanley Park Seawall cycling route, making it a convenient urban refuelling stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record lists this as 'Express Pho' at 570 Bute Street, Vancouver; the auto-discovered website phoexpresschill.com trades under 'Pho Express & Chill' and confirms the same address (570 Bute St, Vancouver, BC V6E4T7) and adds a phone number (+1 (604) 620-8886) absent from OSM. The website confirms active dine-in and online pickup ordering, and the menu page explicitly includes a vegetarian legend icon alongside a no-meat pho option. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere in the website content.
